notes: VAT 12% on full price, bars and jewellery; no retail exemption (relief only for SSM/trader sales to BSP, RA 11256). Jewellery also has 20% excise (NIRC Sec.150). Duty 10% is MFN for gold jewellery per Tariff Finder reports; bullion duty unverified (3% lead), hence low. Bar buyback 10%: Cebuana pays 90% of current price (secondary report). Making is usually flat per-piece labour, not %.
